caption: The video captures a slow descent in a static close-up. A large silver-grey metal cylinder, marked by a horizontal weld seam and a raised bottom rim, occupies the center of the frame. It hovers just above a claw hammer lying on a surface strewn with reddish-brown rubble and white fragments in front of a yellow-and-black hazard-striped platform edge. The cylinder translates steadily downward, its rim closing the gap above the hammer. The black head and claw, clearly visible early on, become progressively hidden until only a thin sliver remains. A small plume of dust at the right base of the cylinder persists and thickens slightly as the descent continues. In a top-left picture-in-picture inset, three people, including two cap-wearing men, watch from outdoors under a blue sky; the men smile, the left one bent forward. The rubble and hazard stripe stay fixed, confirming the cylinder's motion rather than any camera movement.
relations: The cylinder's downward translation closes the gap, progressively obscuring the hammer's black head and claw.
As the bottom rim descends, the dust plume at the cylinder's right base persists and thickens slightly.
The stationary rubble and hazard stripe confirm the cylinder's motion rather than any camera movement.
